tagline: Dedicated to integrity, safety, reliability and operational excellence
hero_kpi_rationale: The rate base is the primary driver of FirstEnergy's regulated growth, reflecting investment in transmission and distribution infrastructure, which directly determines future revenues through rate mechanisms.

kpis.name: Rate Base
kpis.explanation: Total value of regulated assets on which the company can charge a return to regulators.
kpis.description: The rate base aggregates eligible investments in regulated assets (lines, substations, etc.) and serves as the foundation for rate filings.
kpis.signal: Rate base of $21.3 billion by end-2025, reflecting a dominant position in regulated electric services.

kpis.name: Number of Customers
kpis.explanation: Total customers served by regulated electric subsidiaries.
kpis.description: Primary indicator of distribution network size and geographic penetration.
kpis.signal: Over 6 million customers across the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic, with a stable and regulated customer base.

kpis.name: Transmission Miles
kpis.explanation: Total length of high-voltage transmission network operated.
kpis.description: Critical infrastructure for transporting electricity from power plants to distribution zones.
kpis.signal: Extensive network of 24,000 miles of transmission lines, a key element for regional electric system reliability.

kpis.name: Service Area
kpis.explanation: Total area served by electric operations.
kpis.description: Coverage across six states (Ohio, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, Maryland, New Jersey, New York).
kpis.signal: Service area of 65,000 square miles, reflecting high geographic asset density.

kpis.name: Total Workforce
kpis.explanation: Total number of direct employees in regulated subsidiaries.
kpis.description: Sum of reported headcount: OE (1,013), CEI (752), TE (281), FE PA (1,916), JCP&L (~1,200).
kpis.signal: Nearly 5,000 employees, essential for network maintenance and resilience.

risks.title: Securities Class-Action Litigation
risks.score_rationale: FirstEnergy faces significant securities class-action litigation which could adversely affect reputation, business, financial condition, results of operations, ability to access capital, liquidity or cash flows.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: FirstEnergy operates under federal and state regulations that are constantly evolving. Non-compliance risks exist, including those related to the DPA with the SEC and DOJ, which could impact financial results and operations.

risks.title: Reputation and Brand Risk
risks.score_rationale: Reputation is critical to FirstEnergy's business operations and financial results. Damage from litigation, regulatory issues, or operational failures could have substantial negative consequences.

risks.title: Capital Execution Risk
risks.score_rationale: FirstEnergy must execute capital-intensive Energize365 transmission and distribution investment plan and rate filing strategy to support growth and system reliability. Failure to realize anticipated benefits could negatively impact financial performance.

risks.title: Weather and Natural Disasters
risks.score_rationale: Severe weather events and natural disasters, including those exacerbated by climate change, could result in increased restoration expenses, operational disruptions, and material liabilities.

risks.title: Deferred Prosecution Agreement (DPA)
risks.score_rationale: FirstEnergy is subject to a Deferred Prosecution Agreement with the SEC and DOJ. Non-compliance could result in prosecution, significant penalties, and operational restrictions. DPA terms extend through 2026.

ai_positioning.summary: FE does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
